text: Welcome God or Goddess in every person. Behind the social mask, age and status, in every person a divine force manifests, including the archetypal power of the ancient Greek deities. Re-read the myths of ancient Greece. They will help you tune in to the right wave. And then, looking at the woman you are speaking with, see in her a manifestation of Aphrodite, Demeter or Athena… And looking at a man - Zeus, Hermes, Apollo or another god. This turns ordinary relationships into a mythological interaction.
